ownerPrivileges.meaning: Owner controls that trigger the warning. Choices: balance_change, take_back_ownership, mint, hidden_owner, transfer_pause. Measured on ETH Uniswap V2 WETH pools 2023-06..2026-08, normal = pools alive and trading at day 30 (research s15/s16): default → normal tokens 1.1%; + mint → 4.1%; + hidden_owner → 9.6%. Widely used, vetted major tokens (e.g. USDT, USDC) are excluded — the sentence's "알려진 주요 토큰이 아니고".
